dedupe_keys.name: agrolib soil water and agrometeorology libraries

description: Agrolib is an ARPA-SIMC set of libraries for agrometeorological simulation and climate analysis. Its modules include three-dimensional soil water and heat flow, one-dimensional water balance, surface runoff, weather generation, radiation, snow, phenology and plant-water uptake. Users configure weather, soil, terrain and crop parameters; outputs are water, heat or vegetation variables for the simulated field and period. Geographic coverage follows the chosen domain, not a packaged region. LGPL-3.0 source and module descriptions are public. A limitation is that the component libraries need assembly and calibration for a particular application; the README does not present one universal turnkey catchment model. Agrolib can support irrigation demand, drought or runoff scenarios for agricultural and water infrastructure. The related catalogue ERA5 record is a possible weather reference, not a preconfigured Agrolib driver. No terrain, weather data or compiled library were downloaded.
